resources.string: This YouTube link isn’t supported. Share a video, Short, live or playlist link.
This video can’t be played (private, region-locked, age-restricted or removed).
Couldn’t read this video from YouTube. The app may need an update.
YouTube is limiting requests or asking for verification. Try again in a few minutes.
YouTube wants to confirm you’re not a bot. Try again later or on another network.

In the YouTube app (or browser), open a video, Short, live stream or playlist, tap Share, then choose YT Audio. The audio plays in the background with notification and lock-screen controls.\n\nThere is nothing else to set up.
